he.text: Prayers are said as on other week-days, adding עֲנֵנוּ after אַל תְּשִׁיבֵנוּ in שְׁמַע קוֹלֵנוּ in the Ameedah.

en.text: Prayers are said as on other week days, adding in the Ameedah the prayer “Answer us,” page 51.

editorial_expansion: Retain unsupplied weekday Amidah performance instruction.

he.text: Say from סְלַח לָנוּ page 159, till לְכָל־קֹרְאֶיךָ page 160, and continue with the following.

en.text: Say from “Pardon us, our Father,” page 159, till “all those who call on thee,” page 160, and continue with the following—

he.text: הַאֲזִינָה יְיָ תְּפִלָּתֵנוּ · הַקְשִׁיבָה לְקוֹל תַּחֲנוּנֵנוּ · הַקְשִׁיבָה לְקוֹל שַׁוְעָתֵנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ וֵאלֹהֵינוּ · כִּי אֵלֶיךָ נִתְפַּלָּל׃ שְׁמַע יְיָ וְחָנֵּנוּ · יְיָ הֱיֵה עוֹזֵר לָנוּ׃

en.text: O give ear, O Lord, unto our prayer; and attend to the voice of our supplication. Hearken unto the voice of our cry, our King and our God; for

he.text: כְּרַחֵם אָב עַל־בָּנִים כֵּן תְּרַחֵם יְיָ עָלֵינוּ׃ לַיְיָ הַיְשׁוּעָה עַל־עַמְּךָ בִרְכָתֶךָ סֶּלָה׃ יְיָ צְבָאוֹת עִמָּנוּ מִשְׂגָּב לָנוּ אֱלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב סֶלָה׃ יְיָ צְבָאוֹת אַשְׁרֵי אָדָם בֹּטֵחַ בָּךְ׃ יְיָ הוֹשִׁיעָה הַמֶּלֶךְ יַעֲנֵנוּ בְיוֹם קָרְאֵנוּ׃

en.text: unto thee will we pray. Hear, O Lord, and be gracious unto us; O Lord, be thou a help unto us. Like a father hath compassion on his children, so have thou compassion on us, O Lord! Salvation belongeth unto the Eternal, thy blessing be upon thy people. Selah! The Lord of Hosts is with us, the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah! O Lord of Hosts! Happy is the man that trusteth in thee. Save us, O Eternal! Let the King hear us when we call.

he.text: סְלַח־נָא לַעֲוֹן הָעָם הַזֶּה כְּגֹדֶל חַסְדֶּךָ וְכַאֲשֶׁר נָשָׂאתָה לָעָם הַזֶּה מִמִּצְרַיִם וְעַד־הֵנָּה · וְשָׁם נֶאֱמַר׃ וַיֹּאמֶר יְיָ סָלַחְתִּי כִּדְבָרֶךָ׃

en.text: “Pardon, I beseech thee, the iniquity of this people, according to the greatness of thy beneficence, and as thou hast been indulgent to this people from Egypt even until hitherto: (as it is said) And the Lord said, I have pardoned according to thy word.”

he.text: הַטֵּה אֱלֹהַי אָזְנְךָ וּשְׁמַע פְּקָחָה עֵינֶיךָ וּרְאֵה שֹׁמְמֹתֵינוּ וְהָעִיר אֲשֶׁר נִקְרָא שִׁמְךָ עָלֶיהָ׃ כִּי לֹא עַל־צִדְקֹתֵינוּ אֲנַחְנוּ מַפִּילִים תַּחֲנוּנֵינוּ לְפָנֶיךָ כִּי עַל־רַחֲמֶיךָ הָרַבִּים׃ אֲדֹנָי שְׁמָעָה אֲדֹנָי סְלָחָה אֲדֹנָי הַקְשִׁיבָה וַעֲשֵׂה אַל־תְּאַחַר לְמַעַנְךָ אֱלֹהַי כִּי־שִׁמְךָ נִקְרָא עַל־עִירְךָ וְעַל־עַמֶּךָ׃

en.text: O my God! incline thine ear, and hear, open thine eyes and behold our desolations, and the city which is called by thy name; for we do not presume to present our supplications before thee on account of our righteousness but in reliance on thy abundant mercy. O Lord! hear: O Lord! pardon, O Lord! be graciously attentive and grant our request: delay not for thy own sake, O my God! for thy city and thy people are called by thy name.

he.text: אלהינו ואלהי אבותינו תַּעֲנִית צִבּוּר קָבְעוּ תְּבוֹעַ צְרָכִים · שָׁב עָרֹךְ חַפֵּשׂ וְלַחֲקוֹר דְּרָכִים · רַךְ לְרַצּוֹת בִּשְׁלשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה עֲרָכִים · קָשֶׁה לִכְעוֹס תַּת לְאַפַּיִם אֲרָכִים׃ צְדָדֶיךָ מְקֻשָּׁטִים עֵרֹם בְּלִי תַפְשִׁיט · פְּאֵר הָרַחֲמִים וְהַסְּלִיחוֹת הוֹד תַּכְשִׁיט · עֲרֹךְ שַׁוְעָתֵינוּ לְךָ לְבַד נוֹשִׁיט · סֶדֶר הַחַיִּים וּפַרְנָסָה לִיצוּרִים תּוֹשִׁיט׃ נִסְתְּמָה הַבִּירָה וְנִתְרוֹקֵן טוֹהַר הַשֻּׁלְחָן · מִיַּיִן וּמֹחַ סָתַר מֵעֲבוֹדַת פֻּלְחָן לִשְׁפִיכַת הַנֶּפֶשׁ חֲשׁוֹב כְּבָשִׁית׃ צִלְחֵן כְּמַעְתִּיר וּמִשְׂבֵּעַ גּוֹאֵל וְרוֹפֵא וְסַלְחָן׃ יָאוּת לְךָ יַעַן מִמָּנָתְךָ נִשְׁכַּחַת · טוּב וִיחֻדְּךָ הֱיוֹת נִזּוֹנִית וּמִתְפַּרְנֶסֶת · חֵלֶף לְךָ שׁוֹאֶלֶת קוֹבֶלֶת וּמִתְנוֹסֶסֶת · זְכוֹר דַּאֲוֹתֶיהָ לְפָנֶיךָ מְשִׂיחָה וּמְכַסֶּסֶת׃ וְאֵלֶיךָ הִיא נְשִׁיָּה וּבְךָ חֲסִיָּה ·

en.text: Our God, and the God of our fathers. Public fastings have been appointed to pray, that our wants may be satisfied; hence we return, searching and examining our ways, unto thee, who art easily to be appeased by our enumerating thy thirteen attributes, and who art slow in being provoked and long-suffering. O strip not thyself of thy divine crown, thy majestic ornament of mercy and forgiveness; to thee alone we address our prayers, O grant thou life and maintenance to thy creatures. The temple is closed, the holy table is empty, and the offerings on the altar of atonement have ceased; let therefore the pouring out of our souls be esteemed as the effusion of the sacrificial blood, and let the prayers of thy chosen ones be accepted as rich offerings, O our Redeemer, who healest and forgivest us. Let this suffice for thy divine benevolence; instead of offerings, let our lamentation and the memory of our sorrow plead before thee; only in thee we put our trust, therefore avert from us, every calamity. O incomparable Almighty God! It is thy way in portioning out their pay to thy faithful host, to shew thyself

he.text: הַוּוֹתֶיהָ הַעֲבֵר מִי כָמוֹךָ חֲסִין יָהּ · דֶּרֶךְ אֱמוּנָתְךָ בְּחַלְּקָךְ לִלְגִיוֹנָךְ אַפְסַנְיָא · גְּמוֹל חֶסֶד לַעֲלוּבָה הַלָּזוּ אַכְסַנְיָא׃ בְּקִיאִים וּמְיֻשָּׁבִים לְרַצּוֹתְךָ בִּדְבָרִים עֲרֵבִים · אָפֵסוּ פָסוּ בְּכֹחָם קָטֵגוֹר מְעַרְבְּבִים מֵאוֹהֲבֵי לַאֲבִיהֶם שֶׁבַּשָּׁמַיִם זְרִיזִים וּמְעֹרָבִים · יְרָאוּ נִדְבָּרִים הָתוּ שַׁחֲרִים וַעֲרָבִים׃ הִקְדַּשְׁנוּ צוֹם עוֹלְלִים וְזִקְנֵי אֲסֻפּוֹת · יִשַּׁרְנוּ רִנָּה וּתְפִלָּה וְשָׁקַדְנוּ שָׂפוֹת · חֲשׂוֹךְ לְמַטָּה מֵעָוֹן וּשְׁלוֹמֵנוּ הַשְׁפּוֹת · וּזְקוֹף דַּל מֵעָפָר וְאֶבְיוֹן מֵאַשְׁפּוֹת׃ בְּתוֹר הַמַּעֲלָה וּבְמָרוֹת הֲגוּנוֹת תְרוּמוֹת · עַרְבָתֵנוּ שִׂים לְטוֹב יוֹשֵׁב מְרוֹמוֹת · וּבְמִקְוֵה טוֹהַר תָּדִיחַ קַלּוֹת וְרָמוֹת · מְצוֹא תְפִלָּתֵנוּ חֶסֶד לְאָרְךָ רוֹמְמוֹת׃

en.text: magnanimous towards the undeserving, disgraced guests. The intercessors who understood how to persuade by pleasant words, fail; they are gone who knew how to confound the accuser, the active friends and favourites of the heavenly Father, his worshippers, who occupy themselves early and late with his law. We have sanctified a fast, both for the young and the old and experienced; we chant thereon our supplication and prayer, and repeated y visit the house of worship. O regard not our iniquity, but ordain peace for us; raise up the poor from the dust, and the wretched from the dunghill; set us in the ranks of the noble and the virtuous, pledge thyself to grant us happiness, O thou who dwellest in the heavens, and cleanse us from our slight and heavy sins. O let our prayer and our hymns of praise find grace with thee.
i.e., In rewarding the good, let the Lord also graciously remember the sinner.

he.text: Say אֵל מֶלֶךְ and וַיַּעֲבֹר

en.text: Say “Omnipotent King,” “And the Eternal passed,” &c., pp. 11, 12.

he.text: הוֹשִׁיעָה יְיָ כִּי גָמַר חָסִיד · כִּי פַסּוּ אֱמוּנִים מִבְּנֵי אָדָם׃ כִּי אָדָם אֵין צַדִּיק בָּאָרֶץ · אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲשֶׂה־טּוֹב וְלֹא יֶחֱטָא׃ הוֹשַׁע יְיָ אֶת־עַמֶּךָ · אֶת־שְׁאֵרִית יִשְׂרָאֵל׃ יִשְׂרָאֵל נוֹשַׁע בַּיְיָ תְּשׁוּעַת עוֹלָמִים׃

en.text: Help, Lord, for the godly man ceaseth; for the faithful fail from among the children of men. For there is not a just man upon earth that doth good, and sinneth not. Save, O Lord, thy people, the remnant of Israel. Israel shall be saved in the Lord with an everlasting salvation.

he.text: כרחם אב · ליי הישועה · יי צבאות עמנו · יי צבאות אשרי · יי הושיעה · כי לא על · יי שמעה

en.text: Say from “Like a father hath compassion,” till “when we call,” page 9, then say the verses “For we do not presume,” and “O Lord hear,” pp. 9, 10.

he.text: אלהינו ואלהי אבותינו אַנְשֵׁי אֲמָנָה אָבָדוּ · בָּאִים בְּכֹחַ מַעֲשֵׂיהֶם · גִּבּוֹרִים לַעֲמֹד בַּפֶּרֶץ · דּוֹחִים אֶת־הַגְּזֵרוֹת׃ הָיוּ לָנוּ לְחוֹמָה וּלְמַחְסֶה בְּיוֹם זַעַם · זוֹעֲכִים אַף בְּלַחֲשָׁם · חֵמָה עוֹצְרִים בְּשַׁוְּעָם׃ טֶרֶם קְרָאוּךָ עֲנִיתָם · יוֹדְעִים לְעַתֵּר וּלְרַצּוֹתָךְ · כְּאָב רִחַמְתָּ לְמַעֲנָם · לֹא הֱשִׁיבוֹתָ פְּנֵיהֶם רֵיקָם׃ מֵרֹב עֲוֹנֵינוּ אֲבַדְנוּם · נֶאֶסְפוּ מֶנּוּ בַּחֲטָאֵינוּ · סָעוּ הֵמָּה

en.text: Our God, and the God of our fathers! The faithful have perished, who came forward in their energy, and heroically stood in the breach, to thrust aside the evil-doers. They served us as a wall and a shelter in the day of wrath. By their prayers they assuaged his anger, and by their supplication they restrained his hot displeasure. Thou didst answer them even ere they called upon thee; they knew how to entreat and to propitiate thee. For their sakes thou didst compassionate us like a father; thou didst never turn them back empty. Through the multitude of our iniquities we have lost them, through our sins they have been torn from us. They have gone hence to their rest, while we are left to sighing. They who repaired the breach fail, they who appeased his wrath are cut off;

he.text: לִמְנוּחוֹת · עָזְבוּ אוֹתָנוּ לַאֲנָחוֹת · פַּסּוּ גּוֹדְרֵי פֶרֶץ · צוֹמְתוּ מְשִׁיבֵי חֵמָה · קָמוּ בַפֶּרֶץ אֵין · רְאוּיִם לְפַתּוֹתְךָ בְּעֵתֶר׃ שָׁטַטְנוּ בְּאַרְבַּע פִּנּוֹת · תְּרוּפָה לֹא־מָצָאנוּ · שַׁבְנוּ אֵלֶיךָ בְּבֹשֶׁת פָּנִים · לְשַׁחֲרָךְ אֵל בְּעֵת צָרוֹתֵינוּ׃

en.text: there is no longer any one to stand in the breach, or who is worthy to propitiate thee by prayer. Now we are tossed about in all the four corners of the world, and find nowhere relief. We return unto thee with shame, to seek thee early, O Lord, in the time of our trouble.

he.text: Say אֵל מֶלֶךְ and וַיַּעֲבֹר

en.text: Say “Omnipotent King,” “And the Eternal passed,” &c., pp. 11, 12.

he.text: Wherever the words כִּי אַתָּה occur at the end of the verses, repeat from כִּי אַתָּה till וּבַעַל הָרַחֲמִים.

en.text: Wherever the words (For thou art great, &c.) occur at the end of verses, repeat from “For thou art great,” till “full of compassion.”

he.text: יִשְׂרָאֵל נוֹשַׁע בַּיְיָ תְּשׁוּעַת עוֹלָמִים · גַּם הַיּוֹם יִוָּשֵׁעוּ מִפִּיךָ שׁוֹכֵן מְרוֹמִים · כִּי אַתָּה רַב סְלִיחוֹת וּבַעַל הָרַחֲמִים׃ שְׁעָרֶיךָ הֵם דּוֹפְקִים כַּעֲנִיִּים וְדַלִּים · צְקוּן לַחֲשָׁם קַשְׁבִי יָהּ שׁוֹכֵן מְעָלִים׃ כי אתה פְּחוּדִים הֵם מִכָּל־צָרֵיהֶם · מִמְחָרְפֵיהֶם וּמִמְגָדְפֵיהֶם · נָא אַל־תַּעוֹזְבֵם · יְיָ אֱלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵיהֶם׃ כי אתה מִטּוֹבוֹתֶיךָ יִקְדְּמוּ לָהֶם · בְּיוֹם תּוֹכֵחָה · וּמִתּוֹךְ צָרָה הַמְצִיאֵם פְּדוּת וּרְוָחָה׃ כי אתה יִוָּשְׁעוּ לְעֵין כֹּל · וְאַל יִמְשְׁלוּ בָם רְשָׁעִים · כַּלֵּה שֵׂעִיר וְחוֹתְנוֹ · וְיַעֲלוּ לְצִיּוֹן מוֹשִׁעִים׃ כי אתה הַקְשִׁיבָה אָדוֹן · לְקוֹל שַׁוְעָם · וּלְמָכוֹן שִׁבְתְּךָ הַשָּׁמַיִם · הַעֲלֵה תְפִלָּתָם׃ כִּי אַתָּה רַב־סְלִיחוֹת וּבַעַל־הָרַחֲמִים׃ ישראל נושע וכו׳

en.text: Israel is saved by the Lord with everlasting salvation, even this day may be saved by thy mouth, who dwellest on high, for thou art great in pardoning and full of compassion. They knock at thy gates like poor and humble men, O listen to their lowtoned effusion, O Lord, who art enthroned on high. (For thou art great, &c.) They are intimidated by all their enemies who reproach and blaspheme them; O do not forsake them, Lord God of their fathers. (For thou art great, &c.) Anticipate them with thy goodness on the day of chastisement, and from amidst their distress let them find redemption and release. (For thou art great, &c.) Let them be saved in the sight of all the world, and let not the wicked rule over them. Extirpate the tyranny of Seir and his father-in-law, and let the deliverers go up to Zion. (For thou art great, &c.) Attend, O Lord, to the voice of their supplication, and let their prayer ascend to thy heavenly seat, for thou art great in pardoning and full of compassion. (Israel is saved, &c.)
Viz., Ishmael. See Gen. xxviii. 9.

refrain.he: כִּי אַתָּה רַב סְלִיחוֹת וּבַעַל הָרַחֲמִים׃
refrain.en: for thou art great in pardoning and full of compassion.

full_refrain_pattern.en: for thou art great in pardoning and full of compassion\.

he.text: יִשְׂרָאֵל נוֹשַׁע בַּיְיָ תְּשׁוּעַת עוֹלָמִים · גַּם הַיּוֹם יִוָּשֵׁעוּ מִפִּיךָ שׁוֹכֵן מְרוֹמִים · כִּי אַתָּה רַב סְלִיחוֹת וּבַעַל הָרַחֲמִים׃

en.text: Israel is saved by the Lord with everlasting salvation, even this day may be saved by thy mouth, who dwellest on high, for thou art great in pardoning and full of compassion.

he.text: שְׁעָרֶיךָ הֵם דּוֹפְקִים כַּעֲנִיִּים וְדַלִּים · צְקוּן לַחֲשָׁם קַשְׁבִי יָהּ שׁוֹכֵן מְעָלִים׃ כי אתה

en.text: They knock at thy gates like poor and humble men, O listen to their lowtoned effusion, O Lord, who art enthroned on high. (For thou art great, &c.)

he.text: פְּחוּדִים הֵם מִכָּל־צָרֵיהֶם · מִמְחָרְפֵיהֶם וּמִמְגָדְפֵיהֶם · נָא אַל־תַּעוֹזְבֵם · יְיָ אֱלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵיהֶם׃ כי אתה

en.text: They are intimidated by all their enemies who reproach and blaspheme them; O do not forsake them, Lord God of their fathers. (For thou art great, &c.)

he.text: מִטּוֹבוֹתֶיךָ יִקְדְּמוּ לָהֶם · בְּיוֹם תּוֹכֵחָה · וּמִתּוֹךְ צָרָה הַמְצִיאֵם פְּדוּת וּרְוָחָה׃ כי אתה

en.text: Anticipate them with thy goodness on the day of chastisement, and from amidst their distress let them find redemption and release. (For thou art great, &c.)
Viz., Ishmael. See Gen. xxviii. 9.

he.text: יִוָּשְׁעוּ לְעֵין כֹּל · וְאַל יִמְשְׁלוּ בָם רְשָׁעִים · כַּלֵּה שֵׂעִיר וְחוֹתְנוֹ · וְיַעֲלוּ לְצִיּוֹן מוֹשִׁעִים׃ כי אתה

en.text: Let them be saved in the sight of all the world, and let not the wicked rule over them. Extirpate the tyranny of Seir and his father-in-law, and let the deliverers go up to Zion. (For thou art great, &c.)

he.text: הַקְשִׁיבָה אָדוֹן · לְקוֹל שַׁוְעָם · וּלְמָכוֹן שִׁבְתְּךָ הַשָּׁמַיִם · הַעֲלֵה תְפִלָּתָם׃ כִּי אַתָּה רַב־סְלִיחוֹת וּבַעַל־הָרַחֲמִים׃ ישראל נושע וכו׳

en.text: Attend, O Lord, to the voice of their supplication, and let their prayer ascend to thy heavenly seat, for thou art great in pardoning and full of compassion. (Israel is saved, &c.)

he.text: Say אֵל מֶלֶךְ and וַיַּעֲבֹר

en.text: Say “Omnipotent King,” “And the Eternal passed,” &c., pp. 1, 12.

editorial_expansion: English prints pp. 1, 12., apparently omitting the second 1; targets follow the named prayers and complete parallel Hebrew cue.

he.text: Continue from זְכוֹר רַחֲמֶיךָ page 164, till הָרַחֲמִים וְהַסְּלִיחוֹת page 167. The Reader says וְאַל יְעַכֵּב, and the Service is concluded as directed in page 167.

en.text: Say from “O Lord remember thy mercy,” page 164, till “mercy and pardon,” page 167. The Reader says “Let not sin,” &c., and the Service is concluded as directed in page 167.
